FAQ.q1: Do you work with international clients?
FAQ.a1: Yes, I work with clients worldwide as a freelance Full Stack Developer. I have experience collaborating with teams and businesses across different time zones.
FAQ.q2: What technologies do you specialize in?
FAQ.a2: My primary stack includes React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Node.js. I also specialize in WebGL and 3D experiences using Three.js.
FAQ.q3: Do you handle both design and development?
FAQ.a3: Absolutely. I provide end-to-end solutions, starting from UI/UX design in Figma to fully responsive and performant frontend and backend development.
FAQ.q4: How do you ensure the websites are fast and SEO optimized?
FAQ.a4: I utilize Next.js Server-Side Rendering (SSR), strict Core Web Vitals optimization, lazy loading, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategies to ensure high rankings and performance.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.subtitle: Google AdSense & Data Protection Policy
Privacy.intro: At melcadi.com, operated by Mohammad El Cadi (Morocco), accessible from https://melcadi.com, one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy document outlines the types of information collected and recorded by melcadi.com and how we use it, specifically regarding Google AdSense and third-party advertising compliance.
Privacy.adsenseP1: Google is a third-party vendor on our site. It uses cookies, known as DART cookies, to serve ads to our site visitors based upon their visit to www.melcadi.com and other sites on the internet.
Privacy.adsenseP2: Visitors may choose to decline or opt out of the use of DART cookies and personalized advertising by visiting the Google Ad and Content Network Privacy Policy at: https://www.google.com/settings/ads or by visiting http://www.aboutads.info/choices/.
Privacy.logFilesDesc: melcadi.com follows a standard procedure of using log files. These files log visitors when they visit websites. The information collected includes IP addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date/time stamp, referring/exit pages, and number of clicks. These are not linked to any personally identifiable information.
Privacy.rightsDesc: You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data submitted via our contact forms. For any data protection inquiries, contact us at elcadi.mohammad.dev@gmail.com.
Privacy.contactDesc: If you have additional questions or require more information about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact Mohammad El Cadi at elcadi.mohammad.dev@gmail.com or by phone at +212 644 334 262 (Morocco).
